sources.label: APS full text
sources.evidence: pp. 114301-2–3: cohesive stress sigma_c, added group rho0*g*L/sigma_c and bed slope theta; verification via DEM using shaped wheels.

references.supported_use: Limits and extensions of the original cohesionless scaling model. Cohesive or sloped beds require the relevant additional dimensionless conditions to be matched.
references.limits: Does not mean every cohesive granular scaling is impossible. At fixed material, size and cohesion, changing g changes rho0*g*L/sigma_c and invalidates simple similarity unless compensated. Validation here is DEM, not new physical rover tests.
